Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class DriverLimitedThroughputSolver

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.DriverLimitedThroughputSolver
public class DriverLimitedThroughputSolver extends Object
Finds the highest throughput a power-limited common-shaft train can deliver at a fixed discharge-pressure target.

For each trial throughput the caller-supplied setter changes the flow into the train (for example the feed stream flow rate), the shaft common speed is solved for the target discharge pressure of the reference member with CompressorShaft.solveSpeed(neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.Compressor, double, java.lang.String, java.lang.Runnable), and the trial is feasible when the solve is feasible: speed inside the bounds, driver power not exceeded at the site ambient temperature, no surge and no stonewall. The throughput is searched by bisection between a feasible lower flow and an upper flow, assuming feasibility is lost monotonically as the flow rises. The binding limit is read from the solve status of the first infeasible trial. The flowsheet is left at the highest feasible throughput. 


 DriverLimitedThroughputSolver solver = new DriverLimitedThroughputSolver(shaft, lastStage, 85.0, "bara",
     flow -> feed.setFlowRate(flow, "kg/hr"), () -> process.run());
 DriverLimitedThroughputSolver.Result r = solver.solve(20000.0, 90000.0);

    • DriverLimitedThroughputSolver

      public DriverLimitedThroughputSolver(CompressorShaft shaft, Compressor reference, double targetPressure, String pressureUnit, DoubleConsumer throughputSetter, Runnable processRun)
      Constructor.
      Parameters:
      shaft - the shaft with its driver limit and speed bounds already configured
      reference - the member whose discharge pressure is the target (null selects the last active member)
      targetPressure - the discharge pressure to hold
      pressureUnit - pressure unit, e.g. "bara"
      throughputSetter - sets the train throughput in the flowsheet (e.g. the feed flow rate)
      processRun - re-solves the flowsheet, or null to run only the member compressors
